sources.query: SELECT DATASOURCE_NUM_ID, INTEGRATION_ID, LEDGER_WID, ALLOCATED_FLAG, CODE_TYPE, DETAIL_ID, FLEX_VALUE_ID, FLEX_VALUE_SET_ID, TREASURY_SYMBOL_ID, TREASURY_SYMBOL, FUND_VALUE, ALLOCATION_PERCENTAGE, PROGRAM_ACTIVITY_RPT_CODE, PROGRAM_ACTIVITY_RPT_DESC, SEGMENT1_LOW, SEGMENT1_HIGH, DELETE_FLG, PRC_HDR_CHANGED_ON_DT, PRC_HDR_CHANGED_BY_WID, PRC_HDR_CREATED_ON_DT, PRC_HDR_CREATED_BY_WID, PRC_DTL_CHANGED_ON_DT, PRC_DTL_CHANGED_BY_WID, PRC_DTL_CREATED_ON_DT, PRC_DTL_CREATED_BY_WID, PRC_ALLOC_CHANGED_ON_DT, PRC_ALLOC_CHANGED_BY_WID, PRC_ALLOC_CREATED_ON_DT, PRC_ALLOC_CREATED_BY_WID, CFRS_TREASURY_SYMBOL, CMS_PRC_HDR_CREATED_BY_ID, CMS_PRC_HDR_CHANGED_BY_ID, CMS_PRC_DTL_CREATED_BY_ID, CMS_PRC_DTL_CHANGED_BY_ID, CMS_PRC_ALLOC_CREATED_BY_ID, CMS_PRC_ALLOC_CHANGED_BY_ID, PROGRAM_ACTIVITY_RPT_KEY, PROGRAM_ACTIVITY_RPT_KEY_DESC FROM WC_PROGRAM_ACTIVITY_D

-- NOTE: independently reconstructed from the HHS_SIL_ProgramActivity_Dimension mapping's SQ join conditions, the LKP_WC_PROGRAM_ACTIVITY_D lookup key, and the EXPTRANS CMS_* masking rule -- NOT copied from the mapping's SQ 'Sql Query' override text.
-- STEADY-STATE ASSUMPTION: assumes the SIL session has already processed all pending inserts/updates. Rows the Router sends to the DEFAULT (no-op) group are, by definition, rows whose recomputed values already match the target, so a single steady-state recompute covers the Insert, Update, and no-op branches without needing per-branch components.
-- CAVEAT 1 (mapping risk found during review): the mapping's actual SQ SQL override omits CFRS_TREASURY_SYMBOL, PROGRAM_ACTIVITY_RPT_KEY and PROGRAM_ACTIVITY_RPT_KEY_DESC from its SELECT list even though those ports are wired straight through to the target. This query computes them as the pass-through values the mapping's port design implies; if the mapping is actually broken, this DataCompare will surface a mismatch (actual likely NULL) on these three columns -- that is the intended signal, not a query error.
-- CAVEAT 2: the Router only re-evaluates UPDATE when one of PRC_HDR/DTL/ALLOC_CHANGED_ON_DT differs from what's already in the target. This steady-state comparison validates the transformation logic itself; it does not, on its own, prove the changed-on-dt gate correctly catches every source change (that would need a dedicated seeded-data negative test).
-- Business key = (DATASOURCE_NUM_ID, INTEGRATION_ID), matching LKP_WC_PROGRAM_ACTIVITY_D's lookup condition (INTEGRATION_ID = in_INTEGRATION_ID AND DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = in_DATASOURCE_NUM_ID).
-- ROW_WID (sequence-generated surrogate PK) and ETL_PROC_WID/W_INSERT_DT/W_UPDATE_DT (session/run audit metadata) are intentionally excluded -- not independently derivable.
SELECT
  DS.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID,
  DS.INTEGRATION_ID,
  LED.ROW_WID AS LEDGER_WID,
  DS.ALLOCATED_FLAG,
  DS.CODE_TYPE,
  DS.DETAIL_ID,
  DS.FLEX_VALUE_ID,
  DS.FLEX_VALUE_SET_ID,
  DS.TREASURY_SYMBOL_ID,
  DS.TREASURY_SYMBOL,
  DS.FUND_VALUE,
  DS.ALLOCATION_PERCENTAGE,
  DS.PROGRAM_ACTIVITY_RPT_CODE,
  DS.PROGRAM_ACTIVITY_RPT_DESC,
  DS.SEGMENT1_LOW,
  DS.SEGMENT1_HIGH,
  'N' AS DELETE_FLG,
  DS.PRC_HDR_CHANGED_ON_DT,
  U1.ROW_WID AS PRC_HDR_CHANGED_BY_WID,
  DS.PRC_HDR_CREATED_ON_DT,
  U2.ROW_WID AS PRC_HDR_CREATED_BY_WID,
  DS.PRC_DTL_CHANGED_ON_DT,
  U3.ROW_WID AS PRC_DTL_CHANGED_BY_WID,
  DS.PRC_DTL_CREATED_ON_DT,
  U4.ROW_WID AS PRC_DTL_CREATED_BY_WID,
  DS.PRC_ALLOC_CHANGED_ON_DT,
  U5.ROW_WID AS PRC_ALLOC_CHANGED_BY_WID,
  DS.PRC_ALLOC_CREATED_ON_DT,
  U6.ROW_WID AS PRC_ALLOC_CREATED_BY_WID,
  DS.CFRS_TREASURY_SYMBOL,
  CASE WHEN LED.ROW_WID = 2 THEN DS.PRC_HDR_CREATED_BY_ID ELSE NULL END AS CMS_PRC_HDR_CREATED_BY_ID,
  CASE WHEN LED.ROW_WID = 2 THEN DS.PRC_HDR_CHANGED_BY_ID ELSE NULL END AS CMS_PRC_HDR_CHANGED_BY_ID,
  CASE WHEN LED.ROW_WID = 2 THEN DS.PRC_DTL_CREATED_BY_ID ELSE NULL END AS CMS_PRC_DTL_CREATED_BY_ID,
  CASE WHEN LED.ROW_WID = 2 THEN DS.PRC_DTL_CHANGED_BY_ID ELSE NULL END AS CMS_PRC_DTL_CHANGED_BY_ID,
  CASE WHEN LED.ROW_WID = 2 THEN DS.PRC_ALLOC_CREATED_BY_ID ELSE NULL END AS CMS_PRC_ALLOC_CREATED_BY_ID,
  CASE WHEN LED.ROW_WID = 2 THEN DS.PRC_ALLOC_CHANGED_BY_ID ELSE NULL END AS CMS_PRC_ALLOC_CHANGED_BY_ID,
  DS.PROGRAM_ACTIVITY_RPT_KEY,
  DS.PROGRAM_ACTIVITY_RPT_KEY_DESC
FROM WC_PROGRAM_ACTIVITY_DS DS
LEFT JOIN W_LEDGER_D LED
  ON DS.LEDGER_ID = LED.INTEGRATION_ID AND DS.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = LED.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID AND LED.DELETE_FLG = 'N'
LEFT JOIN W_USER_D U1 ON DS.PRC_HDR_CHANGED_BY_ID = U1.INTEGRATION_ID AND DS.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = U1.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID AND U1.CURRENT_FLG = 'Y'
LEFT JOIN W_USER_D U2 ON DS.PRC_HDR_CREATED_BY_ID = U2.INTEGRATION_ID AND DS.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = U2.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID AND U2.CURRENT_FLG = 'Y'
LEFT JOIN W_USER_D U3 ON DS.PRC_DTL_CHANGED_BY_ID = U3.INTEGRATION_ID AND DS.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = U3.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID AND U3.CURRENT_FLG = 'Y'
LEFT JOIN W_USER_D U4 ON DS.PRC_DTL_CREATED_BY_ID = U4.INTEGRATION_ID AND DS.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = U4.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID AND U4.CURRENT_FLG = 'Y'
LEFT JOIN W_USER_D U5 ON DS.PRC_ALLOC_CHANGED_BY_ID = U5.INTEGRATION_ID AND DS.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = U5.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID AND U5.CURRENT_FLG = 'Y'
LEFT JOIN W_USER_D U6 ON DS.PRC_ALLOC_CREATED_BY_ID = U6.INTEGRATION_ID AND DS.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = U6.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID AND U6.CURRENT_FLG = 'Y'
